get_colormap_BGR: get a numpy array of 75 BGR colors scaled to 0-255 for visualization
get_colormap_RGB: get a numpy array of 75 RGB colors scaled to 0-255 for visualization
use_colormap_densepose: use the colormap function to color DensePose segmentation outputs for visualization
customize_colormap_order: customize the colormap by passing rgb=True to get RGB instead of default BGR order
summarize_colormap: summarize the colormap function which returns 75 distinct colors as a float32 numpy array
